Lisa became an integral support not only for my daughter but also our family. My daughter loved Lisa very much and we very quickly trusted her safety, happiness and wellbeing solely in Lisa’s care when we were out or away. Lisa cared for my daughter as well as I did, and she did so with the utmost level of kindness and respect, shown not only to my daughter but also to the other members of our household during her shifts.
Family of high-intensity needs adult participant, 3.5 years support relationship

Mark has had a very positive impact on my life over the past three years. He has helped me get through some challenging situations, get set up with Government services and helped me to live independently when I moved out of home. I also enjoy the bushwalks and trips out. I am now in a shared rental property with my mate and completing a bricklaying apprenticeship.

Nick loves his monthly weekends with Rob and gets very excited when it's in the diary! We love all the exercise you do with him, the good food and even just hanging out together. We have been very happy with his care.
Parents of Nick (17yo); 3 years ongoing support relationship
